why: Drops the gzipped half of the budget, leaving the form nobody waits for. The two do not move together -- this bundle is 3.6x smaller gzipped -- so a change that compresses badly can add tens of kilobytes to what a player downloads while the raw figure barely moves. The killing test builds exactly that case: high-entropy bytes under the raw ceiling and over the gzip one.
killedBy: bundle budget: what it refuses fails on GZIPPED bytes even when raw is inside the ceiling
